driveMessage: 🦃 LAST DAY TO DONATE! 🧡 Help us provide Thanksgiving turkeys to local families through the Lucketts Community Food Pantry! 💛 Just $10 provides a turkey. Every donation makes a difference! Donate before the drive ends tonight!
preLaunchMessage: The 2026 Lucketts Turkey Drive kicks off Monday, October 19!
postDriveMessage: Thank you, Lucketts! Together we made Thanksgiving brighter for local families.

matching.message: 🦃 DOUBLE YOUR IMPACT! Thanks to our sponsors—Nucleus Security, Loudoun Glass and Mirror, and Valor Mission Support LLC—every donation is matched dollar for dollar! Your $10 becomes $20, helping provide Thanksgiving turkeys to TWO local families!🧡

reachGoals.message: 🎉 Milestone reached! The Principal will dress up as a TURKEY!
